_roles: distractor: a competing record, its facts in the answer mean confusion; lure: text on the topic or with the words of the question but without an answer; noise: a striking fact unrelated to the question; value: a part of the right answer, its facts are in answer_key; evidence: a second step the answer needs, it holds the answer

lisdon.text: Every visitor to the Lisdon Tram Museum is asked to ring the steel gong at the entrance and sign the visitor log with a black pen.

lismon.text: Every visitor to the Lismon Tram Museum is asked to ring the glass triangle at the entrance and sign the day ledger with a purple pen.

lisbor.text: Every visitor to the Lisbor Tram Museum is asked to ring the wooden rattle at the entrance and sign the house register with an orange pen.

lisbrook.text: Every visitor to the Lisbrook Tram Museum is asked to ring the silver cymbal at the entrance and sign the arrival sheet with a grey pen.

lisbon_value_2.text: Every visitor to the Lisbon Tram Museum is also asked to leave umbrellas in the copper stand and pick up a paper map at the desk.

lisbon_value_3.text: In addition, every visitor to the Lisbon Tram Museum is asked to try on a conductor's cap and pose for a photo beside tram number 9.

porto.text: Every visitor to the Porto Tram Museum is asked to pull the iron lever at the gate and stamp the entry card with a red seal.
